settings.label: Direction 01
settings.title: Archive
settings.note: Editorial field guide. Serif display, hairline rules instead of boxes, gold as foil on one action, small-caps eyebrows. The baseline — this is the Siwa Design System palette verbatim.

settings.label: Direction 02
settings.title: Oasis Minimal
settings.note: Minimal luxury. Sans throughout, near-monochrome, 1px lines, a third more whitespace than Archive. Ornament off; hierarchy carried by size and space alone.

settings.label: Direction 03
settings.title: Desert Bold
settings.note: Poster graphic. Bone ground, ink blocks, oversized display type, zero radius on every layer, ink borders at 2–3px and a hard offset shadow instead of a blur.

settings.label: Direction 04
settings.title: Nocturne
settings.note: The dark mode. Deep green-black page, gold and silver as light rather than fill, soft wide shadows, high-contrast old-style serif. The boutique after closing time.

settings.label: Direction 05
settings.title: Papyrus Soft
settings.note: Warm and rounded. Pastel parchment, 14px commerce radius, a resting shadow, sentence-case labels, rounded sans. The gifting and mobile-first face.
